# Sukuu Search — Ghana education and national metadata discovery

> Education-first Ghana discovery layer. The deployed school directory contains 10,795 source records representing 10,503 canonical school profiles; national metadata expansion is governed through explicit source, geography and provenance registries.

## Live discovery
- School explorer: https://search.sukuux.com/
- School directory: https://search.sukuux.com/schools/
- Regions: https://search.sukuux.com/regions/
- Districts: https://search.sukuux.com/districts/

## National metadata foundation
- Dataset catalogue: https://search.sukuux.com/metadata/
- Source & authority register: https://search.sukuux.com/metadata/sources/
- Entity/provenance model: https://search.sukuux.com/metadata/model/
- Dataset registry JSON: https://search.sukuux.com/data/registry/dataset-registry.json
- Source registry JSON: https://search.sukuux.com/data/registry/source-registry.json
- Ghana geography index JSON: https://search.sukuux.com/data/geography/ghana-admin-index.json
- Entity schema: https://search.sukuux.com/data/registry/schemas/entity.schema.json

## Methodology
- School data methodology: https://search.sukuux.com/methodology/
- XML sitemap: https://search.sukuux.com/sitemap.xml

Coordinates in the school dataset generally represent approximate towns or localities, not verified school campuses. “Ingestion ready” in the national metadata catalogue means the source authority and schema are defined; it does not mean all upstream records are already copied locally. Accreditation, licensing and deadline data must be revalidated against the named official source before consequential use.
